rationale: The text describes tag management, integrations, customization, and launching tags, which are conventional configuration and integration functions.
evidence_spans: Google Tag Manager 360 gives you simple and reliable tag management that integrates with systems you're already using. Customization features allow you to adapt Tag Manager 360 to suit your exact needs. You'll be able to launch tags faster and make swifter, better decisions about where and how to use them.
